Pranav Kumar
Senior Data Scientist | Secunderabad | pranav.kumar936@example.com | +91 9156544170
Immediate joiner

Data scientist focused on applied machine learning for logistics and education technology. Experienced in building production ML pipelines, optimizing models for operational metrics, and delivering data-driven features that reduce cost and improve efficiency. Strong collaborator in Agile teams with hands-on experience in model training, deployment, and SQL-backed analytics.

Experience

Bluefin Logistics — Jan 2024 - Present
Senior Data Scientist
- Designed and deployed demand forecasting models for regional distribution using time-series features and SQL-backed feature stores, improving forecast accuracy by 18% and reducing stockouts by 12%—leveraged SQL and Machine Learning for feature extraction and model pipeline orchestration.
- Implemented route-optimization scorecards that combined historical pickup/drop patterns with probabilistic demand models, cutting average delivery time by 9% through model-driven prioritization using Machine Learning and SQL-driven evaluation metrics.
- Built an anomaly detection pipeline to flag suspicious shipment delays; integrated alerts into operational dashboards and reduced manual exception handling by 30% using Machine Learning and automated SQL queries.

Kite Learning — May 2018 - Dec 2023
Machine Learning Engineer
- Led development of adaptive learning recommendation engine that personalized course sequencing; A/B tests showed a 22% increase in student engagement and a 14% lift in course completion—implemented core training in TensorFlow and PyTorch and production inference in Python 3.
- Architected end-to-end model training and CI pipeline for content tagging and difficulty estimation, cutting model retraining time by 40% and enabling weekly deployments; used Python 3, TensorFlow, PyTorch and production data validated via SQL.
- Optimized model serving latency for real-time personalization to under 80ms by converting heavy TensorFlow models to lightweight PyTorch alternatives and efficient Python 3 inference code, while maintaining accuracy.
- Partnered with product and QA in Agile sprints to prioritize features, produce reproducible experiments, and document model performance; improved sprint delivery predictability and reduced post-release issues.

Projects
- Personalized Revision Scheduler: A side project that uses spaced-repetition algorithms and supervised predictors to generate daily study plans; implemented training in PyTorch and evaluation pipelines in SQL and Python 3, demonstrating a simulated 25% faster retention in offline tests.
- Lightweight Edge Model Converter: Tool to convert TensorFlow models to optimized PyTorch-compatible formats for low-latency inference on constrained instances; reduced model size by up to 60% in experiments.
